scope: Saved files only. Parse/schema validity is not semantic or clinical correctness.
denominator_note: Each unique cache key counts one saved model request; initial/evidence traces repeat across three Qwen policy records. Tool trace rows are excluded from model-call counts. Error details are first-validator failures, not exhaustive per-response defects.
